brief.text: Associative container where each element is also indexed by time.

content.text: This container mirrors the interface of the standard library ordered associative containers, with the addition that each element is associated with a
which is obtained from the value of the clock's
updates the time for an element to the current time as reported by the clock.
An extra set of iterator types and member functions are provided in the

memberspace that allow traversal in temporal or reverse temporal order. This container is useful as a building block for caches whose items expire after a certain amount of time. The chronological iterators allow for fully customizable expiration strategies.
